= Journal 2026-10-03 =

== Consistent Color Scheme for Windows Terminal, Vim, and Dircolors ==
:vim:neovim:WindowsTerminal:dircolors:LS_COLORS:tinty:

- [[https://github.com/EdenEast/nightfox.nvim|EdenEast nightfox.nvim]] does not support terminal Vim.
  `ctermbg` and `ctermfg` use incompatible defaults.
- [[https://github.com/tinted-theming/tinted-vim|tinted-theming / tinted-vim]] provides
  [[https://tinted-theming.github.io/tinted-gallery/|Tinted Gallery]].
  - Unify `tinted-theming` across Windows, WSL and Vim.
  - Port `vim-solarized8` to `tinted-theming`.
  - Update `dircolors` on `zsh` and `pwsh`.
  - Update WindowsTerminal colorschemes
    so `zsh` and `pwsh` are compatible with terminal vim
  - Update `PSReadline` color options.
  - [[https://github.com/jfishe/tinted-colortemplate|tinted-colortemplate]]
  - [[https://github.com/jfishe/tinted-windows-terminal|tinted-windows-terminal]]
  - [[https://github.com/jfishe/tinted-psreadline|tinted-psreadline]]
  - [[https://github.com/jfishe/tinted-dircolors|tinted-dircolors]]
  - Unify PowerShell 5.1 and 7 profiles:
    - [[https://github.com/jfishe/WindowsPowerShell|jfishe/WindowsPowerShell]]
    - [[https://github.com/jfishe/PowerShell|jfishe/PowerShell]]
  - Add `dircolors` and `Profile.Tinty.ps1`
    to [[https://github.com/jfishe/dotfiles-chezmoi|jfishe/dotfiles-chezmoi]]
    so profiles load without `tinty`.
- Fix Vim terminal underline defaults.
  Neovim and gvim already support.
  [[https://github.com/jfishe/vimfiles|jfishe/vimfiles]]

| Escape Sequence | Meaning              |
|-----------------|----------------------|
| "\e[4m"         | single underline     |
| "\e[4:0m"       | no underline         |
| "\e[4:1m"       | single underline     |
| "\e[4:2m"       | double underline     |
| "\e[4:3m"       | curly/wavy underline |
| "\e[4:4m"       | dotted underline     |
| "\e[4:5m"       | dashed underline     |

{{{vim
if !has('nvim') && !has("gui_running") && &term =~# 'xterm'
  " terminfo specifies Cs (cursor color) which Vim confuses for t_Cs.
  " Vim has no builtin codes for the other underline styles.
  let &t_Ce = "\e[4:0m"
  let &t_Us = "\e[4:2m"
  let &t_Cs = "\e[4:3m"
  let &t_ds = "\e[4:4m"
  let &t_Ds = "\e[4:5m"
endif

if !has('nvim') && !has("gui_running")
  let g:solarized_visibility = "high"
endif

let g:solarized_termtrans = 1
colorscheme solarized8
}}}
